Exact CLI argv regression tests, adjacent nonempty endpoint preservation, and real read-only GitHub endpoint contrast

closed_findings.title: Empty endpoint added a trailing slash to repository metadata requests
closed_findings.evidence: Actual authenticated gh GET repos/Haoog/Adaptive-RSI/ returned HTTP404, while GET repos/Haoog/Adaptive-RSI returned the correct repository and default_branch main. The release script calls gh("") from prepare and gate. Independent inspection found the same construction in the product helper used by workflow_choices.
closed_findings.resolution: Both helpers append slash plus endpoint only when endpoint is nonempty. Nonempty paths, query strings, methods and fields retain the previous exact argument sequence.
closed_findings.prior_test_gap: Higher-level release tests replaced gh/api and accepted the empty logical endpoint without inspecting the physical gh CLI repository path. The new tests assert exact argv for both helpers, and actual read-only calls verify the GitHub contract.

verification.result: Trailing-slash repository root returned HTTP404; canonical root returned full_name Haoog/Adaptive-RSI and default_branch main. Both requests were GET.

Called each modified helper with empty endpoint, commits/main, and releases?per_page=100. Both helpers returned correct repository metadata, the expected main commit, and a release list. All six helper calls were GET and no remote write occurred.

verification.kind: implementation-author actual read-only workflow discovery evidence, independently inspected
verification.result: Actual workflow_choices returned three workflows, all correctly incompatible with the RSI delivery contract. Adjacent commit, associated-PR, matching-ref and release list reads succeeded. Temporary Runtime project was paused, release/deploy disabled, not started; recorded API wrapper allowed GET with no fields only.

verification.kind: static path audit and unit boundary checks
verification.result: Reviewed all gh calls in the release script: prepare and gate share the corrected root helper; commits, pull requests, matching refs and release queries retain nonempty endpoints. Nonempty POST git/refs fields and method are asserted at mocked subprocess boundaries without making any remote write. git diff --check passed.

limits: No real prepare, authorization, tag creation, workflow dispatch, rerun, PR mutation, merge or publication was performed by this reviewer. Actual helper checks were read-only GET requests.
Repository workflows being readable does not mean any is compatible with managed-project delivery; this snapshot returned three incompatible workflows and no compatible choice.
The observed draft/formal release counts are a point-in-time read, not evidence of a successful formal publication.
This follow-up covers the minimal path fix and affected tests. Full hosted CI and actual release continuation remain separate gates.
The previous frozen release review report is historical and was not edited for this follow-up.
